description.narrative:
The Youth-Bond-2025: Civic Innovation Hub is a transformative project fostering collaboration among African youth to address globalgovernance challenges and advance participatory democracy. Through capacity-building activities, the project will empower young leaders from Kenya to co-develop innovative methodologies for enhancing democratic engagement, countering threats to democracy, and advancing youth inclusion in governance, all based and scaling up from past successful initiatives and youth-led programs of WYA Africa.
Key activities include a Capacity-Building Workshop on Participatory Democracy <(>&<)> Youth Engagement in Nairobi, Kenya, where marginalized youth will collaborate with youth leaders and experts to co-create an adaptable participatory democracy methodology. This will be followed by the Human Dignity Curriculum (HDC), equipping youth with the skills to advocate for human rights, ethical leadership and promote safe digital spaces.
The project will also establish the AU Advocacy Academy and Global Governance, where youthwill analyze policies on democracy, digital transformation, human rights and climate governance, proposing solutions to global challenges. The online platform will track AU and UN governance processes, and facilitate policy tracking, youth forums, and advocacy.
A core element is the Youth-Led Civic Forums for Democratic Engagement, engaging 40 youth leaders 20 from Africa in policy dialogue and influence. These forums will focus on the African Youth Charter and local-youth-led solutions to global issues, advocating for inclusive governance and addressing threats to democracy, youth exclusion, and human rights.
The AU Youth Innovation Lab will offer a practical phase where youth design local initiatives to tackle governance challenges. The project will culminate in a hybrid conference with over 100 stakeholders, showcasing youth-led projects, the new methodology, and offering insights into AU and global governance systems.
Focusing on marginalized communities, youth-led advocacy, and institutional responsiveness, Youth-Bond-2025 is a dynamic initiative to empower youth, bridge African-youth gaps in policy development and democratic dialogue, in order to shape inclusive governance frameworks for the future.

participating-org.narrative:
With a strong presence in Kenya and outreach across Ethiopia, Nigeria, Zimbabwe, South Africa, and other AU member states, WYA Africa is a youth-led organization shaping Africa’s youth leaders. Through training, advocacy, and grassroots mobilization, it empowers youth to navigate governance, influence policy, and champion democracy. By connecting African and global youth, it fosters collaboration and equips marginalized voices for meaningful change. Whether through training, civic engagement, or policy innovation, WYA Africa ensures youth are not just participants but architects of Africa’s democratic future.
Mission: WYA Africa educates, trains, andmobilizes youth to engage in advocacy, grassroots movements, and decision-making at all levels to address democracy and human rights challenges, shape policy, and promote human dignity. Vision: A thriving Africa where youth actively participate in governance, influence policy, and drive sustainable development through inclusive solutions.
Objectives:
- Strengthen youth participation in governance through advocacy, human rights, and policy training. - Support grassroots engagement by equipping young leaders to mobilize communities and drive civic action. - Enable marginalized youth to navigate governance and contribute to inclusive policymaking.
Values:
- Democratic Participation: Empowering youth in governance and policy dialogue. - Human Dignity: Upholding fundamental rights and freedoms. - Inclusion <(>&<)> Gender Equality: Ensuring marginalized youth, especially young women, access decision-making platforms. - Ethical Leadership: Developing informed, proactive, and ethical youth leaders.
